items.summary: A study published in Discover Artificial Intelligence in November 2026 reveals that current Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle significantly with the translation of specialized English generative syntax terminology into Arabic. The research, conducted by Mohammed Q. Shormani and Yehia A. items.title: GPT-6.2 Sol Launches in Gray Release, Debuts Atop Leaderboard With Per-Task Cost Just 11.8% of Opus 5.5 — BigGo Finance
items.summary: A "gray release" means OpenAI has not formally launched the model but is first opening it to a subset of users. According to a method circulating on social media, asking ChatGPT "Don't use the internet—do you know Fable 5?" and receiving an affirmative answer indicates inclusion in the test group. OpenAI's developer account simultaneously posted a video titled "Tomorrow," which outside observers interpreted as a signal that a formal launch is near. [...] The release timetable remains uncertain. Over the past week, rumors that gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol were about to launch had been building, but Token Gremlin subsequently reported that OpenAI discovered serious safety and alignment issues in the final stage that required emergency fixes. Some users said they learned from internal channels that the model would be officially released next Thursday, a claim not yet confirmed by the company. [...] OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Sol has been opened to select users in a gray release, and third-party evaluator Artificial Analysis ranks it atop its intelligence index with a score of 60, matching Gemini 4 Carbon and edging out Claude Opus 5.5. The model supports a 1-million-token context window and image-text input, averages 18.7 minutes per task, and costs just $1.19 per task to run—about 11.8% of Opus 5.5's cost and far below market rumors of one-third. items.title: Seattle Schools: 60-Min Screen Cap, What Changes [2026]
items.summary: Google’s side of the story is a change in defaults, which Google made on November 3, 2026. K-12 administrators can now turn Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom and Google Search on or off for student accounts. All four products start in the off position and stay there until an administrator enables them. Chris Phillips, Google’s vice president for education, said the products “will be entirely off for K-12 student accounts until school administrators explicitly turn them on”, per NBC

items.title: What Is Open-Weight AI? How It Works and Why It Matters | Built In
items.summary: Meta has been a catalyst for the open-weight ecosystem since the launch of the original LlaMA model in 2023. In 2025, it launched its Llama 4 models Scout and Maverick, which are both multimodal models with a mixture-of-experts architecture. With a context window of 10 million tokens, Scout employs 109 billion total parameters across 16 experts with 17 billion active parameters.
